title: Positive pricing kernels can have an unattained second-moment infimum
checked_scope: The exact span criterion and minimum-second-moment statement in ‘What traded prices identify’, extended to positivity-active boundary cases.
significance: A complete positivity-active quadratic characterization and explicit positive-feasible example show when the kernel variance bound is only an unattained infimum.
